name: com.traveldeals/hotel-prices
title: TravelDeals
description: TravelDeals' measured hotel prices by city, month and hotel, with the date each was checked.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Lists the cities TravelDeals measures hotel prices in, optionally filtered by a name, with each city’s cheapest month in the year ahead. Use it to find a city’s slug, or to check whether a city is tracked at all: a city that is not listed has no TravelDeals prices.

query.description: A city name, or part of one.

tools.name: city_price_calendar
tools.description: The typical nightly hotel price in one tracked city for each of the next twelve months: the median of one refundable night for two adults across every hotel TravelDeals tracks there, measured weekly on check-in dates spread across the year. Answers “when is <city> cheapest?”. Pass a city slug or exact name (list_cities finds one). Cite the url.

tools.name: cheapest_cities_in_month
tools.description: Ranks every tracked city for one of the next twelve months by how its typical nightly hotel price that month compares with its own twelve-month average: below its usual is a reason to go then, above it is that city’s high season. The same ranking as traveldeals.com/when/<month>. Pass a month name (march) or YYYY-MM. Cite the url.

tools.name: find_hotels
tools.description: Finds hotels TravelDeals tracks by name, optionally within one city, and returns each one’s page and slugs for hotel_prices. No prices. A hotel that is not found has no TravelDeals price history.

query.description: The hotel’s name, or part of it.

tools.name: hotel_prices
tools.description: TravelDeals’ measured prices for one tracked hotel: its headline series (one refundable night for 2 adults, booked 30 days ahead) with the latest reading, 90-day median, low, high and up to 90 dated readings (one reading a night, each for a different check-in date); every other stay length and rate class as its own series (multi-night prices are stay totals); the hotel’s own typical price by month for the year ahead; its cheapest measured nights with a link that opens the hotel page on that date; and a live deal if one is on. These are recorded prices, not live quotes: for today’s room prices, open the url. Pass city and hotel slugs from find_hotels, or a hotel page url.

tools.name: live_deals
tools.description: Hotel stays TravelDeals has verified as priced well below normal and published as deals, live at the time of the call, optionally in one city. Each deal is a specific check-in date and stay length; its price is the stay total. Booking goes through the deal’s url.
